description: This file contains the implementation of the InflateStream class within the GuzzleHttp PSR7 namespace. The class is a stream decorator that uses PHP's zlib.inflate filter to decompress zlib or gzipped content streams, implementing the StreamInterface.

classes.name: InflateStream
classes.description: A stream decorator that inflates compressed zlib or gzip content using PHP's stream filtering, conforming to the StreamInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the InflateStream by wrapping a given StreamInterface, applying PHP's zlib.inflate filter with header detection, and wrapping the resource in a Stream or NoSeekStream depending on seekability.
